envelope.description: Backup restore: restoreDocSummariesFromBackup and the docSummary.restoreFromBackup IPC

body.title: Backup restore: restoreDocSummariesFromBackup and the docSummary.restoreFromBackup IPC
body.summary: Add restoreDocSummariesFromBackup(backupPath) beside the store code: open the backup as a separate read-only lmdb environment (noSubdir), check doc_summary and entity_string_by_u64 exist, walk doc_summary, map each u64 to its string id, decode the value (undecodable on failure), and write through writeDocSummaryIfCurrentInTxn with onlyIfAbsent in batches of 500 per write transaction; close the backup environment in a finally. Register 'docSummary.restoreFromBackup' in the daemon handler map (src/daemon/index.ts, beside repo.reindex at :839) validating backupPath (absolute, a regular file, not the live store's path from getGraphStorePath) before opening anything; return the six counts.
acceptanceChecks: From a test-built backup, restore writes a summary whose document is stored with the same body by either model, and counts already-present, entity-gone, body-changed and undecodable rows.
A second restore writes nothing and the backup file's bytes are unchanged.
A restore whose backup lacks entity_string_by_u64 rejects, writes nothing and leaves the backup environment closed (a second open of the file succeeds).
The IPC call restores over a seeded daemon and rejects a relative path, a missing file and the live store path without writing.

tests.name: src/db/__tests__/doc-summary-restore.test.ts: 'restore writes a backup summary whose document is stored with the same body, by either model, and counts already-present, gone, changed and undecodable rows'
src/db/__tests__/doc-summary-restore.test.ts: 'a second restore writes nothing and the backup file is unchanged'
src/db/__tests__/doc-summary-restore.test.ts: 'a backup lacking entity_string_by_u64 is rejected, nothing is written and the backup is closed'
src/daemon/__tests__/doc-summary-restore-ipc.test.ts: 'docSummary.restoreFromBackup restores over IPC and rejects a relative path, a missing file and the live store path'
